messages:
alex: Heads-up — planning a canary for model v4.1 tomorrow. Need sign-off on percent + region split and rollback guardrails. :eyes:

miriam: proposed plan? quick summary pls (percent + regions + SLOs)

alex: TL;DR: start 1% global for 2h, then 5% for EU only, then 10% global. Rollback if 5xxs > 0.5% or avg latency + p95 > baseline + 200ms. Canary window 4h total.

cheng: what about dedicated customers on Dedicated tier — exclude them from canary?

alex: yes exclude Dedicated and Private deployments. Only Hosted API traffic. We'll set routing rule: tag customer_tier != "dedicated".

oliver: perf/infra check — autoscaler cooldowns are 6m, batching warm-up ~90s. Can we avoid traffic spikes when we flip percents? Recommend step ramp every 20 mins.

kevin: +1 to step ramps. Also suggest warmup with synthetic traffic to populate KV cache for prefix-heavy prompts. I can run a 10-min load job right before cutover.

miriam: can we put a hard cap per-region to avoid EU hotspot? For EU stage, cap region at 7% while global is still at 1% to avoid double counting.

alex: good call. plan: initial 1% global (all regions <=1%), then bump EU to 5% (capped at 7%), then 10% global. I'll update the toggle config.

sara-oncall: oncall here — I'll monitor errors and latency. Add pager rule: if error_rate_1m > 0.5% alert to #eng-oncall and ping me. If p95 latency > baseline+300ms for 5m -> alert.

alex: added alerts and an automatic rollback policy in the flag service: rollback if error_rate_1m >= 0.6% OR p95_delta >= 250ms for 5m. Manual rollback allowed too.

deploy-bot: deploy plan created: canary/v4.1/1865432100. Steps: 1) set flag percent=1 2) wait 20m 3) ramp EU to 5% 4) wait 20m 5) ramp global to 10%. Link: https://redwood.internal/rollouts/1865432100

oliver: quick config snippet pls (so I can validate routing):

alex: here's the flag payload I'm going to apply:

```
{
  "flag": "model_v4_1_canary",
  "scope": "hosted_api",
  "steps": [
    {"duration": "20m", "percent": 1},
    {"duration": "20m", "region": "eu-west-1", "percent": 5, "region_cap": 7},
    {"duration": "40m", "percent": 10}
  ],
  "exclude_tiers": ["dedicated","private"],
  "rollback_conditions": {
    "error_rate_1m": 0.006,
    "p95_delta_ms": 250
  }
}
```

miriam: looks good. Any open dependencies? e.g., model quantization variant, fallback model?

alex: fallback configured: v3.9 stable. Router will fallback automatically on OOM or model not-ready. Also using a quantized variant for lower-cost path but we won’t switch variants mid-canary.

kevin: i'll run the KV warmup job 10m before initial flip and post results here.

alex: thanks — final call: start at 2026-03-18T04:00:00Z. If no objections by EOD I'll apply. :white_check_mark:
